name: Mastok Wrilehiss
summary: At Splintertree Post in eastern Ashenvale, Mastok Wrilehiss helps hold the Horde’s ground. He directs scouts and warriors to watch nearby borders and confront corrupting elemental forces amid the night elves’ hostility.

sections.title: A Bulwark in the Ancient Woods
sections.body: Deep beneath Ashenvale’s canopy, Splintertree Post is surrounded by hostile night elf territory. Mastok Wrilehiss helps defend the outpost and watches its supply routes and the forest around it. The Sentinels see the settlement as an intrusion that despoils their lands, and they strike quickly at any sign of weakness.

sections.title: Coordinating the Front
sections.body: From within the stockade, Mastok gives passing adventurers duties tied to the Horde’s defense. He watches the borders toward the Stonetalon Mountains and sends scouts to speak with shamans such as Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring at Zoram'gar Strand. His work also follows the strange corruption afflicting local elementals.

faq.answer: Mastok Wrilehiss is an orc officer at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. He helps defend the outpost against night elf attacks and investigates threats in the region.

faq.q: Where can Mastok Wrilehiss be found?
faq.answer: You can find Mastok Wrilehiss inside Splintertree Post, a fortified Horde outpost in east-central Ashenvale along the main forest road.

faq.q: What tasks does Mastok assign to adventurers?
faq.answer: Mastok assigns Horde adventurers to investigate corrupted elementals, secure routes toward Stonetalon, and carry messages to Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring.

faq.q: Why is Splintertree Post under constant pressure?
aliases: why are night elves attacking splintertree
faq.answer: Splintertree Post is a Horde logging hub and stronghold in Ashenvale. The night elves regard the orcs’ presence and timber harvesting as a desecration of sacred lands, and skirmishes continue.

faq.q: Why does Mastok send travelers to Je'neu Sancrea?
faq.answer: Mastok sends travelers to Je'neu Sancrea because the Earthen Ring shamans study and heal Ashenvale’s elemental instability. Their knowledge can help address tainted water elementals and strange disturbances.

faq.q: Is Mastok Wrilehiss hostile to Alliance players?
faq.answer: Yes. Mastok serves the Horde and defends Splintertree Post. He attacks Alliance members who approach the encampment.

angles.text: As a Horde champion, you can look to Mastok for duties that help hold the Horde’s frontier in Ashenvale.
Mastok represents the orc military presence in Ashenvale and defends Splintertree Post against night elf Sentinels.
As a shaman, you may be directed by Mastok to seek the Earthen Ring’s guidance at Zoram'gar Strand about corrupted elementals.
